## 📝 Descrição



## 1. What Happened and what were you expecting?

The dcr-test-sandbox-credentials test is looking for a redirect_uri from the configuration JSON, but this test uses a client from a different organization.

It's loading the software statement from : https://matls-api.sandbox.directory.openbankingbrasil.org.br/organisations/d7384bd0-842f-43c5-be02-9d2b2d5efc2c/softwarestatements/3473da82-e233-4da9-a6d5-d898383e2b51/assertion

But our client is at : 

https://matls-api.sandbox.directory.openbankingbrasil.org.br/organisations/effb6cae-e6d6-5f0b-8f31-ee7922850300/softwarestatements/eb13a231-4fb3-4777-a204-a2b22e8a14ec/assertion

So the test will never find the redirect_uri in question.

### Comentário 4
**Autor**: Erick Domingues (@erick.domingues1)
**Criado em**: 11/01/2023, 17:08:41

There are over 100 Redirect_uris registered on the SSA, which also includes the one you mentioned.

However, despite having over 100 uris included on the SSA, we only register on the POST - /reg call the following URI - https://web.conftpp.directory.openbankingbrasil.org.br/test/a/obbsb_3/callback, which is also the one we use on the scope of the test.

When we call the GET - /reg we expect to receive exactly the URI that has been registered - https://web.conftpp.directory.openbankingbrasil.org.br/test/a/obbsb_3/callback. Anything else will be considered a failure, which is the scenario we are facing.



software_redirect_uris: - "https://web.conftpp.directory.openbankingbrasil.org.br/test/a/obbsb_3/callback",
"https://web.conftpp.directory.openbankingbrasil.org.br/test/a/obbsb_3/callback?dummy1=lorem&dummy2=ipsum",

So we should be fine to use those URIs.

A deeper look on your consents-bad-logged test shows that the issue is unrelated to the redirect_uris, and what is happening is that your server is returning an URI on the get that was never registered. Looking at the steps on the tests


1. We create a DCR and register the uri https://web.conftpp.directory.openbankingbrasil.org.br/test/a/obbsb_3/callback

![image](/uploads/40455d2ea58c3af1f9a2800e482b103a/image.png)

2. We conduct a few calls against the client, but no PUTs are done, meaning we wouldn't have been able to update the URI.

3. When we call the GET Configuration endpoint you say the redirect uri is "https://web.conftpp.directory.openbankingbrasil.org.br/test/a/obbsb_3/callback?dummy1=lorem&dummy2=ipsum", which has never been presented to the client.

![image](/uploads/6ed9d8f19392052c2c4141f903de5d22/image.png)

The URI the GET returns has been created on a moment in the past but, as the client has been erased, it should have been removed. Something on your implementation is persisting this URI which brings the issue that is presented

```
actual	
[

]
expected	
https://web.conftpp.directory.openbankingbrasil.org.br/test/a/obbsb_3/callback

```

Again, it seems like there's some mixup in the test suite choosing the wrong redirect_uri

We cannot control those redirect_uris from your hardcoded client.

So we ran the sandbox tests to verify and confirmed that the test suite is indeed choosing incorrect redirect_uri.

Can you please provide the ticket number that pointed to an issue against your server on production so we can investigate what can be the cause? 

We note that the test "dcr-test-sandbox-credentials" has little value to be executed against a sandbox environment because this test aims to confirm that the production server that we test refuses the connection from a sandbox certificate.

Additionally, this test uses a hardcoded sandbox client to be able to conduct the testing so necessarily you will need to set an alias that ranges from obbsb_1 to obbsb_50 to replicate the behaviour. The Production testing tool will always set a random alias on that range, reason why the test works as expected
